newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins steady, wait for U.S. Fed meeting.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins steady, wait for U.S. Fed meeting.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds were steady in a cautious market waiting for a U.S. decision on interest rate policy due on Wednesday, dealers said on Tuesday.

One dealer spreads were wider than usual as dealers were unwilling to open new positions ahead of the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting to consider interest rate policy on Tuesday and Wednesday.
"There have been only a few moves as somebody corrected his position," an ICFI Moscow Partners dealer said. "The market is in wait-and-see mood until an FOMC decision is known."
MinFins, along with other emerging debt, are sensitive to any news suggesting a change in U.S. interest rates and U.S. Treasury bond prices.
Dealers said the majority believed a U.S. interest rate hike was unlikely but the market was already concerned about the next FOMC meeting planned for August 19.
"Many people have mixed feelings as current U.S. statistics are strong and imply a possible rate hike, not this time but in August," the ICFI Moscow Partners dealer said.
Dealers said the market was also waiting for U.S. June unemployment data due on Thursday.
